The target is always the next kink in direction of the engulf. We cannot expect mor3 than that. There is a say I g ifmyante repeats a lot. We cannot expecta level to break. And until it breaks we do not have trade.

So in case where you want big RR for short. the price has to break the first flag limit ( this gives you PA), then you see if it breaks second flag limit while you are in trade (but be cautious as the price can retrace awful a lot back up if there are clean orders above) etc.

This is also mentioned in the holy grail article of the RTM. But it takes time for it to really sink in your head....only time and effort and perseverance will show you what that article really is.
